description: This file defines API routes for managing employee leave requests, including applying for leave, listing requests, approving/rejecting requests, and retrieving leave balances. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and custom schemas and services.

methods.name: _require_employee
methods.description: Retrieves employee UUID from Principal, raises HTTP 400 if not mapped.

methods.name: apply_leave
methods.description: Creates a new leave request for the authenticated employee, with approval logic based on leave type.

methods.name: list_leave_requests
methods.description: Lists leave requests filtered by status and employee, for the organization.

methods.name: decide_leave
methods.description: Approves or rejects a leave request, updates status, and logs the decision.

methods.name: my_balances
methods.description: Retrieves leave balances for the authenticated employee.
